plaintiff.occupation_after: assistant cook (chopping board) at a Kowloon City restaurant

injuries.description: mild head contusion with mild swelling
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

injuries.description: right AC joint dislocation (residue of AC joint dislocation / subluxation)

injuries.description: contusion of lateral epicondyle & olecranon process of right elbow with reduced elbow movement
source: "contusion of lateral epicondyle & olecranon process of right elbow with reduced elbow movement"

injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

manifestations.description: mild head contusion (history recorded by hospital)
local tenderness consistent with residual subluxation
mild reduction of shoulder muscle power
mild reduction of right shoulder active motions

treatments_received.treatment: Accident & Emergency Department treatment at Kwong Wah Hospital
source: "He visited the Kwong Wah Hospital Accident & Emergency Department later that day where he was diagnosed to suffer from mild head contusion with mild swelling, right AC joint dislocation, contusion of lateral epicondyle & olecranon process of right elbow with reduced elbow movement, and 1cm right knee laceration."

losses.description: Residual pain on the right shoulder for two years; not able to raise and rotate his right hand making daily activities inconvenient; difficulty in lifting heavy objects
